dossier_meta.authors: Sands, Bill, Sauer, Norbert W., Woodrow, Robert E.
dossier_meta.subject: Graph Theory » Directed Graphs
dossier_meta.statement_text: Conjecture For every $ k $ , there exists an integer $ f(k) $ such that if $ D $ is a digraph whose arcs are colored with $ k $ colors, then $ D $ has a $ S $ set which is the union of $ f(k) $ stables sets so that every vertex has a monochromatic path to some vertex in $ S $ .
dossier_meta.context_text: In the particular case of tournaments (and more generally when the stabilty number of $ D $ is bounded), it has been proved by Bousquet, Lochet, and Thomassé [BLT].
dossier_meta.references_text:
- [BLT] Nicolas Bousquet, William Lochet, Stéphan Thomassé: A proof of the Erdős-Sands-Sauer-Woodrow conjecture,
- [SSW] B. Sands, N. Sauer and R. Woodrow, On monochromatic paths in edge-coloured digraphs. Journal of Combinatorial Theory, Series B, 33, (1982), 271--275.
